package intervention

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

type interventionTeacherStub struct{ teacher domain.PersonalTeacher }

func (stub interventionTeacherStub) Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	return stub.teacher, nil
}

type interventionStoreStub struct {
	record      domain.InterventionRecord
	decision    domain.TeacherDecision
	already     bool
	deliveredID string
}

func (stub *interventionStoreStub) Commit(_ context.Context, _ domain.LearningActivitySignal, record domain.InterventionRecord, decision domain.TeacherDecision, _ domain.IntegrationEvent) (domain.InterventionRecord, bool, error) {
	stub.record = record
	stub.decision = decision
	return record, true, nil
}
func (stub *interventionStoreStub) HasDeliveredInSession(context.Context, string, string) (bool, error) {
	return stub.already, nil
}
func (stub *interventionStoreStub) MarkDelivered(_ context.Context, _, _, messageID string, _ time.Time) error {
	stub.deliveredID = messageID
	return nil
}

type interventionDialogStub struct {
	appended string
	binding  domain.TeacherDialogBinding
}

func (stub *interventionDialogStub) EnsureTeacherDialog(_ context.Context, studentID, teacherID string, contextType domain.LearningContextType, contextID string) (domain.TeacherDialogBinding, error) {
	stub.binding = domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", StudentID: studentID,
		PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: contextType, ContextID: contextID,
	}
	return stub.binding, nil
}
func (stub *interventionDialogStub) AppendTeacherProactive(_ context.Context, binding domain.TeacherDialogBinding, _, body string) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	stub.appended = body
	return domain.DialogMessage{ID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"}, nil
}

type interventionIDs struct{ values []string }

func (stub *interventionIDs) NewID() string {
	value := stub.values[0]
	stub.values = stub.values[1:]
	return value
}

type interventionClock struct{ now time.Time }

func (clock interventionClock) Now() time.Time { return clock.now }

func interventionRegistry(t *testing.T) *Registry {
	registry, err := NewRegistry("balanced",
		ThresholdPolicy{Mode: "balanced", MinimumFailures: 3, MinimumActiveSeconds: 480},
		ThresholdPolicy{Mode: "quiet", MinimumFailures: 5, MinimumActiveSeconds: 900},
		ThresholdPolicy{Mode: "proactive", MinimumFailures: 3, MinimumActiveSeconds: 300, OfferAfterIdleSeconds: 900},
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return registry
}

func interventionSignal() domain.LearningActivitySignal {
	return domain.LearningActivitySignal{
		EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		AnalyticsSessionID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		LessonID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", TaskID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		SignalType: "repeated_failure", ConsecutiveFailures: 3, SameErrorCount: 3, ActiveSeconds: 480,
		OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 18, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
}

func TestEngineOffersHelpAfterRepeatedFailureThreshold(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 18, 1, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	store, dialogs := &interventionStoreStub{}, &interventionDialogStub{}
	engine := Engine{
		Teachers: interventionTeacherStub{teacher: domain.PersonalTeacher{
			ID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", StudentID: interventionSignal().StudentID,
			Language: "ru", PedagogyProfile: "adaptive", InterventionMode: "balanced",
		}},
		Policies: interventionRegistry(t), Store: store, Dialogs: dialogs,
		IDs:   &interventionIDs{values: []string{"aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"}},
		Clock: interventionClock{now: now},
	}
	processed, err := engine.Handle(context.Background(), interventionSignal())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, processed)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherActionIntervene, store.record.Action)
	require.NotEmpty(t, dialogs.appended)
	require.Equal(t, "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", store.deliveredID)
}

func TestEngineStaysSilentWhileTestsImprove(t *testing.T) {
	signal := interventionSignal()
	signal.SignalType, signal.Progressing = "progressing", true
	store, dialogs := &interventionStoreStub{}, &interventionDialogStub{}
	engine := Engine{
		Teachers: interventionTeacherStub{teacher: domain.PersonalTeacher{
			ID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", StudentID: signal.StudentID,
			Language: "ru", PedagogyProfile: "adaptive", InterventionMode: "balanced",
		}}, Policies: interventionRegistry(t), Store: store, Dialogs: dialogs,
		IDs:   &interventionIDs{values: []string{"aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"}},
		Clock: interventionClock{now: signal.OccurredAt},
	}
	_, err := engine.Handle(context.Background(), signal)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherActionStaySilent, store.record.Action)
	require.Empty(t, dialogs.appended)
}

func TestRegistryAllowsInterventionPolicyReplacement(t *testing.T) {
	replacement := ThresholdPolicy{Mode: "balanced", MinimumFailures: 4, MinimumActiveSeconds: 600}
	registry, err := NewRegistry("balanced", replacement)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	teacher := domain.PersonalTeacher{Language: "ru"}
	underReplacementThreshold := interventionSignal()
	plan := registry.Resolve("balanced").Evaluate(teacher, underReplacementThreshold)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherActionStaySilent, plan.Action)

	underReplacementThreshold.ConsecutiveFailures = 4
	underReplacementThreshold.SameErrorCount = 4
	underReplacementThreshold.ActiveSeconds = 600
	plan = registry.Resolve("balanced").Evaluate(teacher, underReplacementThreshold)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherActionIntervene, plan.Action)
}

func TestRegistryRejectsUnsafeThresholdConfiguration(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := NewRegistry("balanced", ThresholdPolicy{Mode: "balanced"})
	require.Error(t, err)
}

func TestEngineKeepsOneProactiveOfferPerAnalyticsSession(t *testing.T) {
	signal := interventionSignal()
	store, dialogs := &interventionStoreStub{already: true}, &interventionDialogStub{}
	engine := Engine{
		Teachers: interventionTeacherStub{teacher: domain.PersonalTeacher{
			ID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", StudentID: signal.StudentID,
			Language: "ru", PedagogyProfile: "adaptive", InterventionMode: "balanced",
		}}, Policies: interventionRegistry(t), Store: store, Dialogs: dialogs,
		IDs:   &interventionIDs{values: []string{"aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"}},
		Clock: interventionClock{now: signal.OccurredAt},
	}
	_, err := engine.Handle(context.Background(), signal)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherActionStaySilent, store.record.Action)
	require.Equal(t, "session_intervention_cooldown", store.decision.ReasonCode)
	require.Empty(t, dialogs.appended)
}
